issues.title: Severe text truncation
issues.description: Table columns truncate title text excessively on mobile viewports.
issues.evidence: Nearly all title entries end with ellipses (e.g., 'Replace BGP session ...', 'Schedule maintenanc...').
issues.suggestion: Enable multiline text wrapping or stack row metadata for narrow screens.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: 176px of fixed leading columns (checkbox w-10 + expander w-9 + ID w-[100px]) left ~160px for the truncated flexible title at 390px; added a compact sub-sm variant — narrower leading columns (w-8/w-7/w-[92px] px-2), auto-height rows (min-h-9, sm:h-9) and a wrapping title (sm:truncate) instead of ellipsis.

issues.title: Erratic whitespace in title cells
issues.description: Text strings in the Title column contain unnatural spaces inside words.
issues.evidence: Words render as 'Re place', 'us-we st-2', 'tem p fire wall', and 'Ve rify' across multiple rows.
issues.suggestion: Fix font rendering or string formatting to remove spurious whitespace.
issues.triageNote: Source strings contain no spurious spaces and title cells use text-body-medium with letter-spacing 0em; independent eval re-check found the dark-theme rendering clean — JPEG compression misread by the vision audit.

issues.title: Erratic word spacing in Title column
issues.description: Multiple records display unnatural gaps and split words in the Title column strings.
issues.evidence: Text contains splits such as 'Re place', 'Latenc y', 'te mp', 'mainte nance', and 'proc edure'.
issues.suggestion: Correct text string values or fix font kerning/wrapping rules inside grid title cells.
issues.triageNote: Same pattern as pair-020: no intra-word whitespace exists in the authored titles, no tracking on title text, no justify/wrap rules that could inject gaps; re-verified clean — vision-model misread of compressed screenshot text.

issues.title: Missing nested content for expanded row
issues.description: Row PRB-0087 shows an expanded disclosure chevron without rendering nested child records or details.
issues.evidence: Downward-pointing chevron on PRB-0087 with immediate sequence to RITM-5540.
issues.suggestion: Render child rows beneath the expanded parent or revert chevron state to collapsed.
issues.triageNote: Real content defect: PRB-0087's expander glyph was ▾ (expanded) in the static demo content with no child rows; reverted to collapsed ▸ (adding child rows would contradict the surrounding '7 records' copy on the eval pages).

issues.title: Multiline text wrapping in status badge
issues.description: Status label text wraps into two vertical lines within a single cell.
issues.evidence: 'IN PROGRESS' status renders stacked across two lines.
issues.suggestion: Increase column width or set white-space to nowrap with proper badge padding.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: the 'In Progress' StatusBadge (dot + gap + 11px/0.14em tracked label ≈ 100px) exceeded the 120px column's 96px content box; widened the status column to w-[136px] and added whitespace-nowrap so the badge renders on one line.
